_doc: Overrides for onboarding-site/src/stops.py, by the name of a folder of the cache (GTFS_CACHE, default ~/.cache/guest-guides/gtfs-es/): every folder holding a zip is read; this gives a folder its own words {id (short and stable: a stop's id starts with it), name (the publisher as guests read it), credit (the line its terms ask), licence, url (where the file is published), link (where a guest finds timetables)} or leaves it out ({skip: true}). A folder with a meta.json (the national access point's files) and no entry here is credited from it, "Powered by MITRAMS".
